subject.title: feat(mxc): add Windows MXC sandbox backend

question: Should OpenClaw accept the exact @microsoft/mxc-sdk@0.7.0/node-pty dependency graph and SDK argv-carried sandbox config boundary for this official external Windows sandbox plugin after the registration-mode defect is fixed?
rationale: The remaining security boundary is a maintainer/secops policy call because it adds native sandbox executor binaries, install-time native build scripts, and upstream process-argv config exposure.

options.title: Fix Guard Then Approve Exact Head
options.body: Add the registration-mode guard/test, then approve the current dependency graph if secops accepts the native SDK and argv boundary.

options.title: Pause For Safer SDK Transport
options.body: Hold the PR until upstream MXC or OpenClaw provides a non-argv config transport and the dependency guard can be approved against that boundary.

options.title: Defer Official Packaging
options.body: Keep MXC outside the first-party plugin release path until the dependency, packaging, and sandbox boundary are mature enough for official support.

recommendation.title: Fix Guard Then Approve Exact Head
recommendation.body: Add the registration-mode guard/test, then approve the current dependency graph if secops accepts the native SDK and argv boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is assigned on the live PR and is the best available routing owner for the dependency/security acceptance decision.
